kept.name: contextual-retrieval-anthropic
kept.reason: Step-by-step recipe for combining BM25 and embeddings with reranking, with measured gains. Directly applicable as you add embeddings next to lexical search.

kept.name: three-store-hybrid-memory-architecture
kept.reason: Agent-memory architecture that merges vector, exact-lookup and knowledge-graph stores in a fusion layer. Close to your lexical + graph + embeddings design.

kept.name: titans-atlas-cronus
kept.reason: Persistent project memory built on a typed graph, with retrieval that blends lexical, vector, graph and evidence signals. Very close to your approach.

kept.name: okf-agent-memory
kept.reason: Coding-agent memory stored as Markdown+YAML knowledge bundles and searched with in-memory BM25. A direct peer to your lexical layer.

kept.name: open-knowledge-format
kept.reason: Google's Markdown+frontmatter knowledge spec with provenance and freshness signals. Worth comparing against your typed record schema.

kept.name: agentic-memory-benchmark
kept.reason: Benchmark in which a plain curated markdown wiki beat commercial memory products. Evidence for your structured-markdown approach.

kept.name: agentic-rag-terminal-tools
kept.reason: Research showing grep-style direct corpus access beats embedding retrieval. A useful counterpoint before you invest in semantic search.

kept.name: sira-superintelligent-retrieval-agent
kept.reason: Has an LLM add missing vocabulary to documents offline so plain BM25 beats dense retrieval. An alternative or complement to adding embeddings.

kept.name: sira
kept.reason: Code for the SIRA BM25 enrichment pipeline (corpus enrichment, query expansion, reranking).

kept.name: rag-architecture-decision-tree
kept.reason: Choose between Naive, Hybrid, Graph and other RAG designs based on the failures you actually observe, and measure retrieval separately. A useful way to decide when embeddings are worth adding.

kept.name: production-rag-system-taxonomy
kept.reason: Eight-part map of a production RAG system (hybrid retrieval, freshness, evals). A checklist to compare your system against.

kept.name: rag-retrieval-recipe
kept.reason: Practical baseline: chunk sizes, local embedding models, then retrieve top-20 and rerank to top-5. A reference default pipeline.

kept.name: graphrag-agent-memory-linkedin-series
kept.reason: Conceptual grounding on GraphRAG and unified agent memory, relevant to your graph-linked records.

kept.name: karpathy-llm-wiki
kept.reason: The foundational pattern for LLM-maintained markdown knowledge bases, used as an alternative to RAG.

kept.name: kb
kept.reason: Your own repo-local wiki and deterministic graph toolkit. This is the baseline everything else gets compared to.

kept.name: gbrain
kept.reason: Typed memory graph with vector search. Already noted as overlapping with the kb wiki.

kept.name: claude-mem
kept.reason: Coding-agent memory using SQLite + Chroma vector search. Already judged to add complexity over kb; useful contrast.

kept.name: mempalace
kept.reason: Local-first agent memory with a knowledge graph, semantic search and strong R@5 benchmarks. A peer to benchmark against.

kept.name: memoose
kept.reason: Local coding-agent memory on a SQLite knowledge graph with MCP tools. A close alternative design.

kept.name: tencentdb-agent-memory
kept.reason: Team memory hub with linked wiki pages, a code graph and BM25/vector retrieval. A comparable layered design.

kept.name: synapse-memory-layer
kept.reason: Structured memory 'atoms' plus evidence on Postgres+pgvector. One option for adding embeddings to typed records.

kept.name: tolvi
kept.reason: Decision vault with a dual CAG/RAG mode for markdown decisions. Overlaps with kb; useful as a design comparison.

kept.name: mex
kept.reason: Structured markdown agent memory with drift-detection checks. A similar approach without vectors.

kept.name: third-brain-v5-wiki
kept.reason: Wiki knowledge layer whose staleness and contradiction detection was already flagged as worth borrowing for kb.

kept.name: graphify
kept.reason: Direct inspiration for the kb graph (confidence-tagged edges, clustering).

kept.name: fluxmem
kept.reason: Research on a self-repairing graph of semantic, episodic and procedural memory nodes. Ideas for how linked records could evolve.

kept.name: ai-memory-comparison
kept.reason: Sourced survey of 73 agent memory systems across 79 features. Ready-made comparison material for your approach.

kept.name: pageindex
kept.reason: Vectorless RAG that reasons over a tree index. An alternative to embeddings worth weighing.

kept.name: chunkless-rag
kept.reason: Retrieval that navigates document structure instead of fixed chunks. Relevant to structured markdown records.

kept.name: agentic-rag
kept.reason: Iterative retrieval loop where the agent reformulates queries. A pattern to layer on top of hybrid search.

kept.name: pdf-mcp
kept.reason: Working example of hybrid BM25 + semantic search on SQLite, served to agents over MCP.

kept.name: skill-search-mcp
kept.reason: Vector search over short agent-facing descriptions with a measured recall@3. Similar scale and evaluation to embedding your records.

kept.name: lancedb
kept.reason: Embedded, in-process vector store with BM25 full-text search built in. A lightweight way to add a hybrid search backend.

kept.name: qdrant
kept.reason: Vector DB with dense+sparse hybrid search and RRF/DBSF fusion, and an in-process Edge variant. A reference for score fusion.

kept.name: chromadb
kept.reason: Embedding-agnostic store supporting vector, full-text and hybrid search. A common local option.

kept.name: weaviate
kept.reason: Vector DB with semantic + BM25 hybrid search and reranking built in. A reference implementation of hybrid search.

kept.name: pgvector
kept.reason: Postgres vector search that combines with Postgres full-text search for hybrid queries, if you already use SQL.

kept.name: milvus
kept.reason: Vector DB with dense + sparse + BM25 hybrid search; Milvus Lite runs embedded.

kept.name: embeddinggemma-2
kept.reason: Small on-device embedding model for text and code with Matryoshka truncation. A candidate for the semantic layer.

kept.name: five-levels-of-chunking
kept.reason: Chunking strategies from fixed-size to structure-aware. Relevant when deciding how to embed markdown records.
